item.title: Animation studio Pikkukala launches Irish arm in collaboration with Lena Byrne
item.description: Helsinki- and Barcelona-based animation studio Pikkukala has launched a company in Ireland.

item.title: Can the Korean Wave keep rolling?
item.description: SERIES MANIA: With South Korea the country of honour in Lille this week, C21 explores how the Asian nation’s content production sector is changing and what it means for the Korean Wave of programming that has swept around the world in recent years.

item.title: Adam Cunningham promoted to CEO at Allied Global Marketing, Kelly Estrella upped to COO
item.description: US-based market analysis firm Allied Global Marketing has upped Adam Cunningham to the role of global CEO, while Kelly Estrella has been elevated to chief operating officer.

item.title: Scripps Networks unveils new content and sports FAST channel
item.description: US television station group The EW Scripps Company has revealed a slate of original content, including makeover series The Silver Fox Squad and news show Connected with Alisyn Camerota, ahead of its annual upfront event in New York tomorrow.

item.title: Former Netflix/Spotify exec Chris Whiteley joins Apple as country director
item.description: Former Spotify and Netflix exec Chris Whiteley has joined Apple as country director for content and services.

item.title: Doc Sentinels of Antarctica finds buyers as Only Distrib reveals factual slate sales
item.description: Irish public broadcaster TG4 and Canal+ Group-owned channel and content distributor Thema have both acquired documentary Sentinels of Antarctica.

item.title: Germany’s Beta Film boards royal romance drama series Queen Silvia
item.description: Germany’s Beta Film has boarded upcoming royal love story drama Queen Silvia, a 6x60’ coproduction with Pyjama Pictures and Sweden’s Unlimited Stories for Prime Video in the DACH region and Sat.1 in Germany.

item.title: HBO Max strikes first-look deal with ex-Movistar Plus+ content chief Domingo Corral
item.description: SERIES MANIA: Global streamer HBO Max has agreed a first-look deal with Domingo Corral, the former content director at Movistar Plus+.
